column1: # Allowed `static` items of the source tree, one row per static: path<TAB>name<TAB>reason.
# Read by tests/store_url_env_guard_8168.rs (#10213). Every static in every walked .rs file must
# match a row, and every row a static; a key that occurs twice in one file has two rows.
# A new static needs a new row with its reason; a removed static removes its row.
# #10251: a reason is `<category>: <text>`, category one of lock, atomic, once, thread-local,
# immutable, crate-type; every row of a static whose type names a lock says `lock`.
# #10283: a static whose type the census cannot prove lock-free (a trait object, an opaque or
# macro type, a raw pointer, a foreign or unproven std type, an undefined name, an alias cycle)
# says `lock` or is named with its reason in EXCEPTIONS of the test file.
